description: This file defines an abstract base class for Drupal's date format configuration forms, including form building, validation, and saving logic.

classes.name: DateFormatFormBase
classes.description: An abstract class providing a base form for managing date formats in Drupal, including form construction, validation, and persistence.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor injecting date formatter service and date format storage.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate the form with services from the container.

methods.name: exists
methods.description: Checks if a date format with a given ID or name already exists.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Builds the form elements for date format configuration.

methods.name: validateForm
methods.description: Validates the form, ensuring the date format pattern is unique.

methods.name: submitForm
methods.description: Processes form submission, trimming the pattern value.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the date format entity and displays status messages.
